title: Vote: create the apache/iceberg-verification repository
summary: nssalian, with Sung Yun and Andrei Tserakhau, called a vote to create a new standalone repository, apache/iceberg-verification, for language-neutral Apache Iceberg conformance fixtures, following a discussion thread and an earlier community sync. The proposal document is titled 'Shared conformance fixtures for Apache Iceberg implementations'. The vote was to stay open for at least 72 hours; nssalian later extended it to the following Monday morning Pacific time so more people could look. All replies in the thread were +1 votes, several with short comments welcoming the effort, and no +0 or -1 votes or concerns appear. nssalian closed the thread saying the voting had concluded and passed, and that a separate result email would follow.

positions.stance: Create a standalone apache/iceberg-verification repository for language-neutral conformance fixtures.

outcome.note: The closing message states that the vote concluded and passed; it gives no counts and says a result email will follow. All votes in the thread were +1.

why_it_matters: Iceberg implementations in different languages get a shared home for conformance fixtures, where contributors can add cases that all implementations are checked against.
